about: The basmala line of every surah (all but 9), verbatim from the signed KFGQPC Word file of each riwayah: surah -> [index of the w:p element in word/document.xml, its text]. 'official' is al-Fatiha's basmala without surrounding whitespace or verse number, the default line. Written by vendor_sources.py --basmala; never edit by hand (see SOURCES.md).
